visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright indoor space with white blinds, a man with messy blonde hair and a grey shirt performs a 'kabedon' (wall slam) against a wall, pinning a man wearing glasses, a light blue dress shirt, and a grey tie. The man in glasses looks surprised with an open mouth and wide eyes. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The scene cuts to the blonde man pointing a thumb at himself with a confident smirk. The setting shifts briefly to a plain white room before cutting to both men squeezed together under a low wooden desk. A third man in a white shirt and black bowtie, wearing a comical fake paper mustache, points toward them while speaking. (3) The background changes to a dark grey brick wall. The man with glasses, now wearing a black patterned sweatshirt with purple text, sits on the floor. A fourth man with curly black hair, yellow-tinted sunglasses, and dragon-tattoo sleeves holds a black handgun, cocking it and adjusting his glasses while staring intensely at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with swelling, dramatic orchestral BGM featuring strings and piano, creating a mock-romantic atmosphere. A male voice speaks with deep, exaggerated authority and an arrogant tone. A second male voice responds with high-pitched, stuttering breathiness, indicating extreme anxiety and high arousal. (2) A low-frequency rumbling SFX, mimicking an earthquake, suddenly overlaps with the voices. The BGM maintains its tempo but the speech becomes more frantic, with the first male voice shouting over the noise. A series of percussive impact sounds occur as if objects are falling. (3) A new male voice with a calm, flat delivery enters briefly. A sharp 'thud' SFX signals a transition to a softer, mysterious synth-pad BGM. The first male voice returns to a conversational volume, speaking rhythmically about musical performance. (4) A metallic mechanical click of a pistol slide being cocked triggers a shift to a tense, fast-paced electronic beat (~120 BPM). A gruff male voice with a thick accent and low pitch speaks aggressively. The protagonist's voice sounds exhausted and shaky, with frequent pauses and high pitch variability.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Parody Tropes -> Subversive Earthquake -> Mafia Dream Sequence -> Punchline
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic parody of 'Boys' Love' (BL) and 'Overbearing CEO' drama tropes. It uses exaggerated visual staging and melodramatic audio to set up a romantic cliché, only to subvert it with an earthquake and then pivot into an absurd mafia-themed dream sequence to mock the ubiquity of such plotlines.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video relies heavily on audio-visual contrast to deliver humor, particularly the use of romantic BGM against non-romantic situations.
